remediation.issue: The OpenAI-compatible provider treated the configured proxy origin as an API root and requested /chat/completions.
remediation.fix: The agent-owned provider now appends its fixed /v1 API root before constructing the model client.
remediation.regressionTest: The provider test starts from an origin and asserts the resulting request path is /v1/chat/completions.

limitations: The durable stream remained open after session.waiting, so the bounded CLI read ended by timeout after receiving bytes; this is not a failed session.

The receipt proves one completed session and replay event sequence. It does not retain a per-session proxy request counter, so it does not independently prove the absence of an additional upstream call beyond Eve's replay semantics.
